notes.title: Crimson Viper Coming to iPhone in Free Update to Street Fighter IV
notes.content:
Another World Warrior is jumping into the fray with blazing fury, as newcomer C.Viper is being added to the iPhone version of Street Fighter IV.

Today, Capcom announced the cellphone-addicted Crimson Viper will be added to the mobile version in a free update.

Previously, Zangief and Cammy had been added to the mobile version's growing roster, which will stand at eleven fighters when C.Viper makes her debut.

Capcom has yet to announce a date for the Crimson Viper update, but we're keen on waiting a little while. It will give us enough time to shudder at the possibility of controlling the complex super-spy on a touch screen.
